verdict.rationale: Gram documents building MCP servers that authenticate through an external OAuth 2.0 provider you have set up, such as Auth0, Okta, Keycloak or your own OAuth server. That partially covers using your own OAuth credentials and server in the authorization flow. Nothing in the evidence shows custom branding or white-labeling of the consent or login screens. Missing for 10: custom branding and white-labeled authorization UI, explicit configuration of your own OAuth client ID and secret, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials

citations.quote: you can use any OAuth 2.0 provider you have set up (such as Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, or your own OAuth server)
This guide shows you how to build an MCP server with external OAuth authentication.
